# OffsetOperations

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `OffsetOperationsInspection`

Offset access `$x[...]` only works on arrays, strings and objects that
implement offset handling. Using it on a boolean, number or a plain object is
a bug (or a sign of missing type annotations); using an index whose type the
container does not accept (an array as a key, an object as a key) is also
flagged.

Disabled by default.

## Example

```php{13,17,21,24,27}
<?php
class Registry {
    /** @param string $name */
    public function offsetGet($name) { return null; }
}
class Dyn {
    public function __set($k, $v) {}
}

function demo(array $rows, int $limit) {
    $title = 'abc';
    echo $title[1];
    $title[array_keys($rows)] = 'z';
    $title[] = 'x';

    $count = 10;
    $count[2] = 1;

    $reg = new Registry();
    echo $reg['db'];
    echo $reg[7];

    $dyn = new Dyn();
    $dyn[new ArrayObject()] = 1;

    $plain = new DateTime();
    $plain[] = 1;

    foreach ($rows as $k => $v) {
        echo $k[0];
    }
    $tail = substr('abc', 1);
    echo $tail[0];
}

/**
 * @param mixed $m
 * @param \Countable|array $c
 * @param null|array $n
 */
function ok($m, $c, $n) {
    return [$m['a'], $c['a'], $n['a']];
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 13: Index of type array does not fit the accepted string|int.</li>
<li>line 17: &#39;$count&#39; does not support offset access (types: int).</li>
<li>line 21: Index of type int does not fit the accepted string.</li>
<li>line 24: Index of type \ArrayObject does not fit the accepted string|int.</li>
<li>line 27: &#39;$plain&#39; does not support offset access (types: \DateTime).</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "OffsetOperations": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore OffsetOperations

/**
 * @noinspection OffsetOperationsInspection
 */
```
